description: Prevent exhausted provider quota failures from dispatching Workflow Agent recovery while preserving ordinary recovery behavior.

Pi provider quota and usage-limit failures retain the original provider message and emit the same internal marker.
Transient retry behavior and all non-provider runtime failures remain unchanged.
tasks.output: Runner runtime-to-Action failure marker propagation and focused runtime tests.

tasks.title: Veto Agent recovery for exhausted provider failures
tasks.description: Make the shared recovery boundary return the original failed result for the provider-quota-exhausted marker while preserving ordinary recovery matching.
acceptanceCriteria: No recovery handler task or retrySelf task is added for provider-quota-exhausted.
The original failed result and provider message are returned unchanged.
Ordinary script failure recovery remains covered and passes.
